messages:
Maria: Vendor notified split shipment for H100 top-up — 14 to EU pool, 6 to US. Customs hit in AMS; vendor opened RMA for 2 DOA + 1 serial mismatch. Need invoice split and provisional credit proposal.

David Ops: Share AWBs, invoice refs and RMA please.

Lia (Vendor): AWBs: `AWB-UK77221100` (AMS -> EU), `AWB-US11002233` (SEA -> US). Original invoice `INV-4098-RED` total USD 1,092,000. RMA: `RMA-9902`. Depot raised partial replace for 2 DOA + 1 unit flagged for serial verification. Depot ETA 36-60h post customs release.

Noah: timeline ok if customs moves. What's vendor offering for DOA / mismatch? Any temporary loaner option to cover capacity gap?

Sylvie (Vendor): Options: (A) 10% credit on DOA units + full replacement at no cost; (B) ship 2 refurbished loaners from our EU loaner pool to cover until replacements arrive (no charge for up to 10 days). Also willing to absorb depot staging fee (~$1,500) if loaners used. For serial mismatch we'll either re-ship correct SN or provide swap — pending root-cause.

Maria: Prefer loaners if available — reduces our provisioning risk. But need a written proforma showing line-item credits and loaner terms. Also need invoice split for VAT handling.

Lia (Vendor): Will generate proforma credit note and split invoices `INV-4098-EU` and `INV-4098-US` by EOD. Proforma CN `CN-4098-1` will show 10% credit on 2 DOA units (unit price listed $41,000), loaner line with 0 charge for 10 days if accepted, and staging credit $1,500. Shipping prorated by unit weight.

David Ops: Accounting asks that CN references `RMA-9902` and the depot RMA handler. Also confirm whether EU invoice will include VAT — we need net vs gross for AP.

Lia (Vendor): CN updated with `RMA-9902` and depot handler `Markus V.`. EU invoice will include VAT where applicable; US invoice will be net (no VAT). We'll prorate shipping and list tax breakdown per invoice.

Noah: Important: warranty start date for replacements/loaners — do loaners start new warranty or keep original warranty for unit replacements? We need SLA clarity.

Sylvie (Vendor): Loaners are covered under a 30-day limited loaner SLA (repair/replace). Replacements carry original warranty start date. We'll note this in CN and in the RMA ticket.

Maria: Customs in AMS flagged ECCN/HS mismatch + commercial invoice. Lia, push ECCN and commercial invoice to customs contact and share the link. SupplyBot, please monitor.

Lia (Vendor): Uploaded COM INV and ECCN to customs contact. Link: `https://vendorfiles.example.com/4098/cominv.pdf`.

SupplyBot: Monitoring AWBs `AWB-UK77221100`, `AWB-US11002233`. Will post updates. :robot_face: 

SupplyBot: 2h update — `AWB-UK77221100` placed on documentation hold: customs asked for ECCN which was uploaded. ETA review 4-8h.

David Ops: If depot ETA drifts >72h, approve air uplift for replacements. Please confirm who will absorb expedited freight if that happens.

Sylvie (Vendor): We'll absorb expedited freight for the 2 replacement units if uplifted due to vendor delay. Loaner uplift costs covered by us for first 10 days.

Maria: Good. Also reserve 2 inbound rack slots at HNL-AMS for QA/burn-in on arrival and schedule depot bench test (4h per unit). Noah, can you reserve power and thermal probes?

Noah: Reserved 2 slots Monday 08:00-12:00 local. Thermal probes and QA bench scheduled. Will also reserve 1 day of on-call eng if we see serial mismatch issues.

Lia (Vendor): Draft CN `CN-4098-1` uploaded: credits = $8,200 (10% on 2 DOA units @ $41,000 each equals $8,200), staging credit $1,500, prorated shipping adj $780. Will amend invoices accordingly.

David Ops: Please ensure CN ties to `INV-4098-EU` and `INV-4098-US` with line-level adjustments. Accounting will reject otherwise.

Lia (Vendor): Noted — CN references both amended invoice numbers. Added depot handler and RMA refs.

Maria: We'll accept CN once customs clears. If loaners are shipped, document serials in the thread and mark them as loaners. If replacements are air-lifted, vendor to confirm ETA and tracking.

SupplyBot: `AWB-UK77221100` status: released 05:22 UTC. Forwarder contact: Elena / AirFast Logistics +44 7700 555123. Forwarder ETA to crossdock 10:00 local, depot ETA ~28-36h post-release.

David Ops: Forwarding to depot ops now. Depot Ops: please confirm receipt and QA readiness.

Depot Ops: Acked. We'll QC on arrival and log any SN mismatches to `RMA-9902`.

Maria: Closing for now pending final invoices/CN and loaner/replacement shipping confirmation. Reopen if any hiccups. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

Lia (Vendor): Will post final docs here when ready.

Sylvie (Vendor): Thanks — will coordinate loaner pickup if approved.

Noah: Added tracking links:
`https://track.airfast.com/awb/UK77221100`
`https://track.airfast.com/awb/US11002233`

SupplyBot: Will attach vendor docs to thread when uploaded.

Maria: Thread closed pending final docs.
